description: Baseline verification: ensure the project builds cleanly on the feature/win11-ui branch before any changes are made.
steps: Confirm git branch is feature/win11-ui: run 'git branch --show-current'
Run the build: dotnet build source\BulkCrapUninstaller\BulkCrapUninstaller.csproj -p:Platform="Any CPU" -c Release
If build fails, record the error in findings and mark blocked. If build succeeds, mark completed.
acceptance_criteria: dotnet build exits with code 0 and prints 'Build succeeded'
findings: Branch confirmed as feature/win11-ui. Build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors (exit code 0). Output: bin/Release/Any CPU/BCUninstaller.dll. Build time: ~41s. Baseline is clean and ready for UI changes.
